method: Full reviewed support; source-color-near candidates (per-channel <=1), plus 2px-eroded ink interiors to retain top-wash variation, avoid deliberately using edge AA as foreground; these are core candidates, not native alpha/coverage proof; high-contrast strong-ink segmentation and a 2px exclusion band separate candidate backing. All support backing, not selected favorable pixels, supplies conservative observed extrema. Radius2-5 sensitivity retained. Segmentation is a measurement aid, not an independent glyph oracle or a proof of hidden backing.
limitations: Only these three stable revealed layouts and available originals are assessed.
Finite sequential screenshots/hierarchies are not atomic callback proof.
A below-threshold support bound does not by itself prove background beneath glyphs is below threshold; inspect the candidate point.
No trait inference, original issue resolution, accessibility readiness or original offscreen contrast claim.

Full-glyph coverage needs human support/mask review; near-background AA is deliberately not counted as core. Candidate cores are not native alpha proof, and the 2px exclusion leaves immediate fringe/hidden backing unmeasured.
